name: CoreContextTabs
intent: Page-level context tabs under the top bar for switching sections of the current entity.
when: Switching sections of a project/org page (Overview/Schedule/Quality)

chooseOver.because: Tabs for in-component views; CoreContextTabs for page-level section nav in the shell

usage: Use CoreContextTabs to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

CoreContextTabs is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.

anatomy.description: CoreContextTabs is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Keep tabs concise
bestPractices.description: Use short, descriptive labels for tab triggers.

bestPractices.title: Don't use long tab labels
bestPractices.description: Avoid lengthy text that causes tabs to wrap or overflow.

bestPractices.title: Maintain content relationship
bestPractices.description: Ensure tab content is clearly related to the tab label.

bestPractices.title: Don't use for navigation
bestPractices.description: Use proper navigation components for page-level routing.

bestPractices.title: Show active state clearly
bestPractices.description: Make the selected tab visually distinct from others.

bestPractices.title: Don't hide the active indicator
bestPractices.description: Always show which tab is currently selected.
